official_commit_message: BSL-13,BSL-14 | Upgrade. Bump OpenMRS image version to 1.1.3
why_selected: Official Bahmni install page says Docker is the recommended evaluation path and older RPM installs are unsupported.
Official July 02 2026 Bahmni security patch notes list 1.0.2-standard as the patched Standard Docker distribution.
The tag resolves to an immutable commit and includes OpenMRS image 1.1.3 / bahmni-core 1.2.1 security patch line.

Standard exposes the broadest connector-relevant local lab surface: Bahmni Web, OpenMRS, OpenELIS, Odoo, reports, appointments, patient documents, inpatient UI, PACS, and optional SNOMED/CDSS profiles.
